summary.text: Anna Ferguson is the Republican state representative for North Carolina House District 119, appointed on April 16, 2026, and is the Republican candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The General Assembly lists her occupation as small business owner and her district as Jackson, Swain and Transylvania counties.

paragraphs.text: Ferguson earned a bachelor's degree from North Carolina State University, and Ballotpedia lists her career experience in construction finance.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was born and raised in the Qualla Community, is the third generation to live on her family farm, and has been a small business owner for over 30 years.
She said she was appointed board chair for the EBCI Internal Audit and Ethics board and has served on the Cherokee Planning Board and the North Carolina Community Foundation.

Ferguson serves on the House Appropriations, Health, Higher Education, and Emergency Management and Disaster Recovery committees, and is vice chairman of the Federal Relations and American Indian Affairs Committee.

In the same survey, she named rural health care resources, public education funding and the state budget process among her campaign messages, and said economic development in rural Western North Carolina is essential to the success of her community.
